prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single tightly cropped dialogue head portrait for a grounded medieval RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is Toman's previous identity and costume master only; do NOT preserve its large cartoon eyes, chibi proportions or full body. Image 2 (Mara), Image 3 (Ivo), Image 4 (Leiya) and Image 5 (Tor) are approved portrait STYLE masters only. Match their serious adult anatomy, close framing and purposeful hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters, without copying their faces.
Primary request: redraw the SAME character Toman So (托曼·索, NPC07), a pragmatic route guide around forty years old, as an extreme-close HEAD portrait intended for a logical grid of 74 pixels wide by 100 high. If larger output is necessary, make it look like an integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of this coarse grid; do not create fine details for downsampling.
Identity: square slightly broad face, substantial straight nose with clear nostril wings, prominent cheekbone planes, weathered warm skin, thick charcoal eyebrows, short unruly salt-and-pepper hair visible inside a worn brown traveler hood, compact salt-and-pepper mustache and beard. Keep enough dark hair and mature strength to read forty rather than elderly. Face turned mildly toward viewer-left; small narrowed eyes glance farther left as if measuring a safe road. Expression cautious, practical, attentive and restrained; firm closed mouth, no scowl, smile or villainous look. The hood leaves BOTH eyes and eyebrows fully visible. Preserve original warm brown hood, dark brown coat edge and a tiny off-white undershirt edge.
Composition: tight head crop, hood crown almost touches upper edge; face from brow to chin fills the central image; cheeks and beard occupy most width, chin near lower edge, only tiny collar sliver at the bottom. Head and hood together fill over 90 percent of canvas width and height, with transparent corners. No chest expanse, no full body, no hands, route bag or walking stick. Hood is ordinary practical cloth, not a fantasy mage hood, no pointy wizard crown.
Pixel treatment: a few broad brown hood folds, 4 connected dark/gray hair masses, compact beard built from 3 large angular masses. Strong warm near-black silhouette. Clear angular nose bridge and nostril shape, cheekbone lights and coherent broad face shadows. Small dark iris and eyelids; only very small muted-ivory eye slivers, no large eye whites, sparkle or pretty anime eyes. At most 32 visible flat RGB colors in this batch, muted earth palette with warm terracotta skin and gray-brown hair. Hard pixel steps, no gradients, soft airbrush, antialiasing, noisy texture, dithering, individual hair strands or scattered bright beard pixels.
Transparent alpha outside silhouette. One person, one portrait only, no props, text, logo, frame, grid, panels, UI, background, medals, armor or magic.
